architecture.boundary.limitation: Checks only declared source import patterns; it does not prove runtime dependency isolation or resolve every language-specific import form.

ast.unsafe-boundary.limitation: Does not prove that safe code is correct.

commands.allowlist.limitation: Does not prove an allowed command is safe for every workspace.

complexity.cyclomatic.limitation: The metric does not assess domain correctness.

database.app-layer-join.limitation: The heuristic requires domain review for unusual query abstractions.

dependencies.deny.limitation: Does not replace vulnerability scanning or lockfile review.

scope: SQL, TypeScript, and JavaScript database-facing source
postgres.tenant-boundary.limitation: Markers and documentation do not prove runtime isolation, RLS behavior, or query correctness.

security.artifact-redaction.limitation: Pattern checks cannot identify every secret format.

security.hardcoded-secret.limitation: Heuristic detection cannot identify every secret.

typescript.any.limitation: Generated and unsupported-language code is outside this check.

typescript.console.limitation: Static analysis cannot judge whether a log is operationally useful.

typescript.duplicate-logic.limitation: Normalization can miss semantically equivalent implementations.

typescript.eval.limitation: Runtime behavior outside parsed files is not assessed.

typescript.type-error.limitation: Diagnostics depend on the repository's compiler configuration and installed declarations.

typescript.unused-variable.limitation: Intentional side effects and dynamic access may require review.
